home.signalDesc: A place for things I've tinkered with, everyday notes, and moments I like. Kept light, updated slowly.

intel.title: Site Meaning
body: In this wasteland of information, this site is meant to be a minimal anchor.
Its name comes from an obsession with efficiency and whitespace — or perhaps just a randomly generated ID.
Here we record fragments, searching for faint logical connections in the dark.

core.title: Tech Stack
body: The core engine is built on Next.js 15+, using the latest React Server Components architecture.
The visual layer is powered by Tailwind CSS v4, blending tactical HUD with 8-bit pixel aesthetics.
Deployed on Cloudflare edge nodes for fast, stable data streaming.

build.title: Build Process
body: This project was built from scratch, using designs from the ReactBits component library.
The whole process was done in Warp, with Manus generating the initial UI prototype.
Manual work and logic refactoring were layered on top of the AI output to keep the visuals distinct.
